thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: embedding-service error-rate alert triggered. 5xx spike -> 25% over 30s. Paging eng-oncall.
alex_chen: Oncall here, grabbing it. Which cluster/region?
mira-g: saw this on eu-west-1, autoscaler didn't kick fast enough. I'm going to scale replicas to 6 for the embedding workers.
alex_chen: thx — runbook link? and any visible customer impact yet?
jordan_prod: I'm pulling customer requests. Preliminary: three customer accounts saw 500s for embed endpoints starting ~12:08UTC. No SLO breach yet but degraded tail latency.
samir_ops: can we suppress duplicate alerts? we're getting the same alert from both raw 5xx and error-rate composite.
cecile_sre: yes, we should annotate the alert and add a squelch window during active mitigation. Also want a short-lived threshold adjust while autoscale settles.
alex_chen: mitigation done: scaled to 6 replicas, restarted the prefetch workers on the problematic nodes. CPU spiked during restart, watching.
mira-g: confirmed restart complete. error rate falling: 25% -> 6% in last 45s.
incident-bot: Incident note: hand_off_needed=true, assigned_to=alex_chen for live triage. Incident ID: INC-2026-0420-019
samir_ops: customer impact: collected request IDs for affected customers, sending to support. No widespread data loss.
jordan_prod: added customers to this thread: Acme Corp, BrightHealth, SketchFlow. Support notified.
cecile_sre: Proposed alert change for follow-up: change alert "embedding_service_5xx_rate" from threshold 10% over 30s to 15% over 2m and add a one-hour mute during planned escalations. Also create a derived dashboard panel for 90th/99th latency by customer.
alex_chen: sounds reasonable. We should also add an annotation to the alert in Grafana with a link to the runbook and incident id.
mira-g: I'll update runbook with the exact mitigation steps + playbook snippet. New runbook section: "Scale embed workers, restart prefetch, check KV cache hit-rate". Will link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/embed-service (draft)
cecile_sre: Example patch to monitoring config (will submit in infra-mon repo):

```
- alert: embedding_service_5xx_rate
  expr: sum(rate(embed_http_requests_total{code=~"5.."}[2m])) / sum(rate(embed_http_requests_total[2m]))
  for: 2m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "embedding-service 5xx rate > 15% (2m)"
    runbook: "https://internal.redwood/runbooks/embed-service"
```

And add an `annotations/incidents` field with `{{ $labels.incident_id }}` when firing.

alex_chen: please include the CLI to update alert temporarily if we need hotpatching. e.g.

```
# one-off silence for 1h
alerter silence create --alert embedding_service_5xx_rate --duration 1h --reason "autoscale in progress" --owner alex_chen
```

mira-g: I'm making the runbook edit now. Adding step: "annotate last firing with incident id and owner" and a code snippet to run the silence CLI above.
samir_ops: I'll own the post-incident ticket and follow-up tasks. Assigning: MON-5242 (post-incident action card). Owners below:
- alert tuning: cecile_sre
- runbook edits + examples: mira-g
- dashboards: jordan_prod
- postmortem writeup: samir_ops

alex_chen: Handoff to night oncall in 30m — adding short status update to oncall channel and pinning runbook link. current state: degraded -> recovering, 5xx down to 2% in last 5m.
cecile_sre: I'll push infra-mon PR to change threshold and add annotation template. tagging @infra on PR.
jordan_prod: dashboard panel created (temp): https://grafana.internal/d/embeds/embed-overview?orgId=1 — includes customer filter and 99p latency.
mira-g: runbook URL (updated draft): https://internal.redwood/runbooks/embed-service#incident-INC-2026-0420-019
samir_ops: postmortem ticket MON-5242 created: https://issues.internal/REDWOOD/MON-5242 — linking this thread and runbook. ETA: draft in 72h.
alex_chen: final note for handoff: if error-rate rises above 12% for >3m, escalate to infra and open hotpatch. Otherwise follow post-incident tasks. :thumbsup:
mira-g: copying the new runbook section into the repo, will ping once PR is live.
cecile_sre: leaving ownership marker: alert-config-review -> approver: @cecile_sre. Will annotate running incidents in grafana with `incident_id` and `owner` fields.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident INC-2026-0420-019 moved to status: monitoring. Pager silences applied: embedding_service_5xx_rate (1h) by alex_chen.
